text: Changeover M to L took 20 min, fixture alignment was slow. Otherwise smooth.
Quick changeover to M, 15 min. CNC-21 fan sounds louder than usual.
Changeover to product H, 20 min. No issues.
Line 2 stopped 25 min, CNC-21 spindle over-temp alarm. Let it cool, maintenance cleaned the fan grille, restarted. Running product H at low rpm.
Changeover L to M on CNC-12, 15 min. All fine.
Planned lube and inspection on CNC-11 first hour, as scheduled. CNC-12 overload alarm at 10:45 on a heavy cut, tool was past its wear limit. 35 min stop, 9 parts scrapped.
Changeover H to L, 20 min.
CNC-31 controller froze at 09:15. Reboot fixed it, 15 min lost. Maintenance found nothing in the logs.
CNC-21 over-temp again at 02:30, 30 min stop. Shop is cold tonight but the spindle still got hot. Product H, about 1300 rpm.
CNC-21 fan filter is clogged. Cleaned the grille as a quick fix. The filter replacement work order WO-1013 is still open, no spare filter in stock.
Planned coolant and way-cover service on CNC-31, 45 min, done on time.
Changeover L to M on CNC-22, 20 min. 6 extra parts scrapped on first-off check after changeover.
CNC-11 spindle drive power fault at 16:20. Line down 50 min. Maintenance found a loose motor cable connector.
Changeover to L, 15 min. Good shift.
Third CNC-21 over-temp this week, 35 min stop. Ran slower after restart to keep temperature down.
Escalated CNC-21 overheating to maintenance planner. Spare filter ordered, delivery unknown.
End mill on CNC-31 worn out at 03:05, 20 min for tool change.
CNC-22 drill chipped at 12:10, 20 min stop. Tool life counter had not been reset at the last tool change.
Changeover L to M, 20 min.
Changeover to product H on CNC-22 at start of shift, 20 min.
Line 2 stopped 40 min at 01:50, CNC-21 spindle overheating again. Cooled and restarted. Ran at 85% feed override for about an hour after restart.
Cleaned CNC-21 filter with compressed air. Temporary only. Spindle temp will climb again within 1-2 shifts on product H. New filter needed (WO-1013).
CNC-22 end mill broke at 04:20, 25 min stop. 18 parts with burrs scrapped. Tool life counter not reset again.
Changeover L to M at 23:30, 15 min. Quiet night otherwise.
No stops. CNC-11 running well since the cable fix.
No stops. Coolant level topped up.
